datasheet_identity.title: UMW AO4406A, 30 V N-Channel Enhancement Mode MOSFET

extraction_notes: The electrical-characteristics table is headed TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise noted; unqualified table values inherit that condition.
No ID-versus-VGS transfer-characteristics figure is published. Transfer data was not fabricated; output characteristics and capacitance traces were digitized from the available typical figures.

Fig. 1 output curves are typical ID versus VDS traces for VGS = 3 V, 4.5 V, 5 V, 7 V, and 10 V. Only points within the plotted 0 to 42 A range are retained; high-current portions clipped by the graph boundary are omitted.
Fig. 7 capacitance traces are typical Ciss, Coss, and Crss versus VDS at VGS = 0 V and f = 1 MHz. The capacitance y-axis is logarithmic and the VDS axis is linear from 1 V to 25 V.
RDS(on) publishes both typical and maximum values at VGS = 10 V, ID = 10 A and at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 8 A. Both column semantics are preserved as separate schema-conformant entries.
The table also publishes IDSS maximum 1e-6 A at VDS = 24 V, VGS = 0 V and maximum 5e-6 A at VDS = 24 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 55 degC; the strict schema has no off-state field, so these are retained here.

Gate resistance is 2.2 ohm typical and 3.8 ohm maximum at VDS = 0 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz. Total gate charge is 1.26e-8 C typical and 1.76e-8 C maximum; Qgs is 4.2e-9 C typical and 5.9e-9 C maximum; Qgd is 5.1e-9 C typical and 7.1e-9 C maximum, with VDS = 15 V, VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 10 A.
Reverse recovery is trr = 1.25e-8 s typical at IF = 10 A and di/dt = 1.0e8 A/s, with Qrr = 5e-9 C typical at TJ = 25 degC.
Thermal resistance maxima are RthetaJA = 50 K/W and RthetaJC = 30 K/W for the specified surface-mounted 1 inch squared FR-4, 2 ounce copper test board; the strict schema has no thermal field.
BVDSS temperature coefficient is 0.027 V/K typical referenced to 25 degC at ID = 1 mA. VGS(th) temperature coefficient is 0.0058 V/K typical at VGS = VDS and ID = 250 uA.
omission_reason: No ID-versus-VGS transfer-characteristics figure is published in the supplied datasheet; transfer-curve extraction is therefore omitted.
